build: HEAD fe674dc (worktree), balance data_version 45 (ship_cap 6, win_earliest_cycle 23, win_gate_cycle 38)
harness: qa/bots/bot_run.gd; new option --skip-tutorial (QA 2026-11-05, uncommitted, see 2026-11-05-bot_run-skip-tutorial.patch). Runs: 183 in 2026-11-05-runs.jsonl. Batch tags: fast (no skip), skip, timer, mkt_<market>, np_all, np_mil, ae_perm_mil.

issues.run_id: fast_decent_1 (also fast_decent_2..5, fast_sloppy_1..5, fast_always_expand_1..5, fast_never_expand_1..5, fast_spread_1..5, fast_mining_focus_1..5, fast_dead_run_1..5, fast_passive, fast_local_focus_1..5)
steps: Run: GODOT=<godot> STRATEGIES=decent SEEDS=1 TAG=probe LIMIT=300 qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>
Read the RESULT line: ships_owned 0, lanes_built 0, ship_buys [], cash 2100 flat for 27 cycles, issues: softlock from cycle 1.
Run the same seed with EXTRA=--skip-tutorial: 6 ships, 9-13 lanes, a win or soft end at 40.
local_focus shows 2717 order_failed entries: 'buy energy order at planet 0 did not switch to on (notice: Not yet. Follow the tutorial step, or skip the tutorial.)'.
issues.expected: A player (or a scripted player that uses the same signals) can buy the first ship and place orders at the start of the game. The tutorial waits for the step, it does not block the whole economy.
issues.actual: From cycle 1 the tutorial gate blocks ship buys and Buy/Sell orders for all planner strategies. Zero decisions in 45 of 50 runs. Only the --skip-tutorial flag gets a run going. Whether a human can get stuck the same way is UNKNOWN; the bot may be wrong about the step, so the owner must check by hand.

issues.run_id: skip_always_expand_3 (bio win at 38); mkt_bio_decent_1..5; mkt_min_decent_1..5; mkt_lux_decent_1,2,4
steps: Run: STRATEGIES=decent SEEDS='1 2 3 4 5' EXTRA='--skip-tutorial --market=bio' TAG=mkt_bio LIMIT=300 qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>
Read win_streaks and cycle_reached in RESULT. bio seed 1: win_streaks bio 9 at the end, win at cycle 31 (hold met from 23).
chain_picks_game shows BIO_B4 chosen; the win waits for B4 (chains.gd win_open) or cycle 38.
issues.expected: Biotech and Minerals focused decent players win in the 22-30 window (targets skilled 22-26, no-skill 26-30), or the design says why the chain step is the pace.
issues.actual: Biotech wins at 31, 32, 32, 36, 39 (all after 30). Minerals at 28, 31, 32, 35, 40 (4 after 30). Luxury at 32 and 40. The 5-cycle share hold is met by cycles 23-27; the win waits for the market's B4 chain step, which fires later than in Military (27-30). Inference from RESULT fields; the exact B4 trigger timing is UNKNOWN.

issues.run_id: skip_decent_1..5 vs np_all_decent_1..5 and np_mil_decent_1..5; ae_perm_mil_always_expand_1..5 vs mkt_mil_always_expand_1..5
steps: Run: STRATEGIES=decent SEEDS='1 2 3 4 5' EXTRA='--skip-tutorial --no-permit --market=mil' TAG=np_mil LIMIT=300 qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>
Compare to EXTRA='--skip-tutorial --market=mil' (permit 2 bought at cycle 10 by default).
always_expand with EXTRA='--skip-tutorial --permit=2 --market=mil' vs without.
issues.expected: Permit 2 is one option among several for reaching a win; a run without it can still win, or the design states that it is required.
issues.actual: No run without permit 2 wins: decent no-permit 0/5 base and 0/5 Military; always_expand no-permit 0/5 in all four focus markets. With permit 2: decent 18/25 wins across the focus markets and base; always_expand 5/5 in Military (27-38). One win in the batch (always_expand base seed 3) had no permit. Mechanism not traced: UNKNOWN. Owner decision: is permit 2 a required step to win, and does a human see that?

steps: Run: STRATEGIES=decent SEEDS=1 EXTRA='--skip-tutorial' TAG=skip LIMIT=300 qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>
Read ship_buys (6 buys, last at cycle 13) and cash_by_cycle (cash 11k by 25, 42k at 40).
issues.expected: The ship cap and the share growth keep cash and volume in step, so a winning player converts cash into share.
issues.actual: Ships reach ship_cap 6 by cycle 12-16 on every buying strategy. Cash then climbs to 14k-40k by cycle 40 with no sink, and the share falls after cycle 20-25 as rivals grow (decent seed 1: Military 0.46 at c19 to 0.33 at c40). Proposed: ship_cap 6 to 8 (test) or a cash sink. Economy designer to decide.

steps: Run: STRATEGIES=local_focus SEEDS=1 EXTRA='--skip-tutorial' TAG=skip LIMIT=300 qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>
Read share_rows at cycle 1: 0.64 Military (Minerals 0.74) with 1 ship, 0 routes, 0 lanes.
Read cash_by_cycle: cash 26-497 at cycle 40.
issues.expected: Market share reflects delivered volume that earns margin; a player with no routes should not hold the largest share at cycle 1.
issues.actual: Local Buy and Sell orders (no route, no ship beyond the tutorial one) give 0.64-0.75 share at cycle 1, against 0.28-0.30 for a single lane. Share then decays to 0.32 by cycle 40 as cash runs out. Local-order volume seems to count toward share without margin. Owner decision: count sold volume, or cap local-order volume. Mechanism not traced: UNKNOWN.

steps: Run: STRATEGIES='sloppy never_expand' SEEDS='1 2 3 4 5' EXTRA='--skip-tutorial' TAG=skip LIMIT=300 qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>
Read share_rows: Military share 0.30 at cycle 1, 0.17-0.25 from cycle 5 to 40, and outcome.
issues.expected: A one-lane player is swept (END_SWEPT, cycle 25 or later, share under sweep_share_pct 0.10 for 3 cycles), as in the 2026-11-03 batch (sloppy swept at 27).
issues.actual: All 10 one-lane runs end soft at 40 (END_OUTCOMPETED), none swept. Share stays above 0.10 because one lane gives 0.17-0.31. The sweep no longer catches weak one-lane play. Proposed: sweep_share_pct 0.10 to 0.20 (test). Owner decision.

issues.run_id: skip_decent_2 vs timer_decent_2; skip_decent_1 vs timer_decent_1; skip_always_expand_2 vs timer_always_expand_2
steps: Run: STRATEGIES='decent always_expand' SEEDS='1 2' EXTRA='--clock=timer --skip-tutorial' TAG=timer LIMIT=600 qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>
Compare final_cash with the fast run of the same seed and strategy (TAG=skip).
issues.expected: The same seed and strategy give the same economy on --clock=fast and --clock=timer (the timer only changes how cycles are stepped).
issues.actual: decent seed 2 cash 28,960 (fast) vs 16,579 (timer); decent seed 1 42,379 vs 33,334; always_expand seed 2 19,436 vs 8,080; never_expand within 6%; sloppy identical. Clock-dependent outcomes make fast-clock balance numbers unreliable for the player (who runs the timer). Cause UNKNOWN.

issues.run_id: every batch that opens an event notice (for example fast_decent_1 log: 'Case mismatch opening ... ev08.webp.import', and ev07)
steps: Run any batch and grep the log for 'Case mismatch opening requested file'.
game/main.gd:2476 builds 'res://art/event_banners/%s.webp' % id.to_lower(); the files in art/event_banners are EV01.webp ... (uppercase).
event_notice.gd _load_banner returns null when ResourceLoader.exists is false.
issues.expected: Event banners load on every platform, including the case-sensitive export targets (Linux).
issues.actual: On this case-insensitive Mac the banners load with a Godot WARNING; on a case-sensitive file system ResourceLoader.exists returns false and the banner is silently missing (fallback art). The code comment 'files are lowercase' is wrong. Owner to pick one fix (rename files or lower-case the path).

issues.run_id: mkt_min_decent_2 (5 repossessions, 11 ship buys); mkt_min_decent_3,4 (1 each); mkt_lux_decent (3 total); skip_spread (4 total); timer_decent_2 (2)
steps: Run: STRATEGIES=decent SEEDS='1 2 3 4 5' EXTRA='--skip-tutorial --market=min' TAG=mkt_min LIMIT=300 qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>
Read repossessions and ship_buys; read cash_by_cycle cycles 3-25.
issues.expected: A focused decent player does not lose ships to repossession in the early game.
issues.actual: Minerals decent: 7 repossessions in 5 runs; a ship is bought again after each one (seed 2 bought 11). Cash is 300-1,100 from cycle 3 to 25 in these runs. Proposed: maintenance 45 to 40 (test), only if the rate stays high after the ship_cap test. Economy designer to decide.
